summary: Grants.gov joins query words with OR and never says so, so report each word's own hit count instead of filtering.
reason: A word that matches nothing leaves the result set unchanged, so a typo returns the other word's results with no signal that half the query was discarded. Filtering is not available as a remedy: the search response carries no description field, and descriptions require one extra request per record.
validated_outcome: Live API: "climate" 61 hits, "climate zzzqqqxxx" also 61, "zzzqqqxxx" alone 0. Title-only AND filtering was measured and rejected — 1 of those 61 titles contains the stem "climat", and it is the stalest record in the set.
